title: Basin: Efficient and Extensible Numerical Optimization in Rust
abstract: arXiv:2608.11279v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Basin is a numerical optimization library for the Rust programming language. Numerical optimization is the task of finding the inputs that minimize a function, and it is a fundamental element across the sciences: fitting a model to data, calibrating a simulation, training a machine learning model, or choosing engineering parameters that minimize cost. Basin gives users a single, consistent way to both state and solve such problems, with a broad catalog of solvers and first-class support for constraints.

translated_title: Basin：Rust中高效且可扩展的数值优化库
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11279v1 公告类型：新 摘要：Basin是一个用于Rust编程语言的数值优化库。数值优化是寻找使函数最小化的输入的任务，它是科学领域的基本要素：将模型拟合到数据、校准模拟、训练机器学习模型或选择最小化成本的工程参数。Basin为用户提供了一种统一、一致的方式来表述和解决此类问题，拥有广泛的求解器目录，并对约束提供一流支持。

en_tdlr: Basin offers a unified, extensible numerical optimization framework for Rust, integrating diverse solvers with first-class constraint support to streamline optimization in scientific computing.
